svg.title: Mock Topic Insights dashboard
svg.desc: Mock Contact Intelligence dashboard, Topic Insights page (demo, mock data). Sidebar: Performance, Topic Insights (selected), Named Entities, Trends, Contact Table, Session Review. Operational metrics: contact volume 412,500; average handle time 09:45; average hold time 01:10; transfer rate 18.0%; average sentiment 0.61; resolution 72.4%. Bar chart of calls by topic group, where shares can exceed 100% because a call can have several topics: Benefits and coverage 128K calls (31%), Claims 96K (23%), Find care / network 71K (17%), ID cards and enrollment 48K (12%), Billing and payments 41K (10%), Pharmacy 33K (8%), Website / app 27K (7%), Unfiltered 29K (7%).
svg.text: What are members contacting us about? A call can have more than one topic.
